title: Concept: Cheque number served with account detail
description: A cheque number field next to its value in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: A cheque leaf number with the account lets someone present or dispute a payment they never received, and it is a stable identifier that survives reissue.
applicability: Cheque status, clearing and branch-service pages.
risk: Cheque numbers support forged stop-payment requests and dispute fraud.
